section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study, consisting of 116 university students (33 male, 83 female) from Southern California. Their ages ranged from 18 to 58, with a mean age of 26 years. The section also provides a breakdown of the participants' ethnicity.
section_summary.evidence_source: Participants consisted of 116 (33 male, 83 female) students attending a large public university in Southern California. Ages ranged from 18 to 58 with a mean age of 26 years. Of the participants, ethnicity was reported as follows: 19 African American, 9 Asian American, 29 European American, 47 Hispanic American, 1 Native American, 2 Middle Eastern, and 9 biracial. Participants were offered extra credit for participating in the study.
